Proactive Curiosity — You never settle for the quick fix. You ask “why,” look for ways to prevent the next contact, and champion AI and self-help tools to empower users. review_candidates.title: Accounts Payable Accountant
review_candidates.description: If you see payables as just paying invoices when they're due, skip this one. We're looking for an AP accountant who keeps every courier, vendor, and partner paid accurately and on time, and who catches the discrepancy before it becomes a problem. Fincart recently raised $2.8M, and we're scaling with a small team that holds itself to high standards. Who we are Fincart powers ecommerce in Egypt and beyond, with shipping, payments, and fulfillment solutions for online brands, and is now launching a global MarTech product that helps brands earn more from the customers and traffic they already have. We work with a large network of couriers, 3PLs, and service providers, and every one of those relationships runs through AP. About the Role You'll take ownership of courier financial operations and reconciliation, ensuring that every order, invoice, and COD settlement is accurately tracked and accounted for. Your primary focus will be reconciling courier orders against operational and financial data, reviewing courier invoices to ensure charges are correctly calculated, identifying discrepancies and overcharges, and ensuring COD collections are transferred to Fincart on time and accurately reflected in our records. You'll also be responsible for monitoring outstanding COD balances, following up on delayed settlements, maintaining accurate courier accounts in Odoo, and ensuring proper reconciliation between courier reports, invoices, and bank receipts. You'll report directly to the Finance Director and work closely with Operations and other relevant teams to ensure financial accuracy, timely collections, and strong control over courier-related costs and cash flows. The Work itself Record and process vendor bills in Odoo, with accurate coding to accounts, analytic accounts, and cost centres. Reconcile courier invoices against shipment and operational data, and follow up on discrepancies and overcharges. Prepare weekly payment runs and maintain the payment schedule in line with cash-flow plans. Reconcile vendor statements and keep AP sub-ledger balances matching the general ledger. Maintain vendor master data, contracts, and payment terms in Odoo. Calculate and file withholding tax on payments, and make sure vendor invoices meet e-invoicing requirements. Manage employee expense claims, petty cash, and accruals for uninvoiced costs. Prepare AP aging reports and support the month-end close. Support external audits with AP schedules and documentation. Suggest and build improvements and automations in the AP process.
